# Admiral Jim (Jim Kukral)

> Cleveland entrepreneur, author and keynote speaker. Performs as Admiral Jim with Sink Your Worry, a hilarious, heartfelt, interactive keynote about worry, overthinking and actually enjoying your life. Now booking 2027.

## Talks
- Sink Your Worry: Float Above It (interactive keynote, 45 to 60 minutes)
- Sink Your Worry: Take Back the Helm (workshop, 90 to 120 minutes)
- Both end with the Sink Your Worry ceremony: audiences write a worry on dissolving paper, drop it in a cup of water and watch it disappear.
- For corporate teams, associations, chambers, nonprofits, conferences, schools, and healthcare and wellness events.

## Credentials
- 26 years in attention-getting marketing; built and sold two online marketing agencies
- Consulted for FedEx, Sherwin-Williams and Fortune 500 companies
- Adjunct professor of internet marketing, University of San Francisco, 10+ years
- 20+ years on stages, over 200 talks
- Founder of the Cleveland Floaters and LET'S GO CLE
